picks.title: 希望
picks.summary: 20世纪70至80年代，生活在非军事区附近孤立村庄——湖浦港的居民，与不明外星生物对抗。
picks.summaryEn: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems

picks.title: 猛攻
picks.summary: 军事基地逃出了一个神秘的危险存在，被佣军追捕，威胁到了一名此前曾是军人、如今因为某些原因住在拖车里的母亲。为保护所爱之人，她不得不使出特殊技能。
picks.summaryEn: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

picks.title: 属于我的孩子
picks.summary: 在这部令人震惊的纪录片中，承受家人和社会的期望的女子迫切地想要个孩子，因此假装怀孕，并卷入一起犯罪。
picks.summaryEn: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

picks.summaryEn: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

picks.summary: 工薪阶层的西蒙·沃德接连遭受毁灭性重击，家中遭入室洗劫、职场处处碰壁，挚友又意外离世，多重困境将他逼至崩溃。电台主持人极具煽动性的话语不断放大他心底的愤懑，被极端舆论裹挟的他逐步滑向暴力深渊，以极端方式反抗不公，彻底陷入失控的人生泥潭。
